data.standardized_narrative: Unable to extract reliable gross claims reserve opening balance or a clear gross prior-year reserve movement from the provided images. The PDF images contain relevant tables and notes (technical provisions, claims movement tables and segmental analysis) but characters and numbers are not sufficiently legible to assert gross reserve figures or prior-year development amounts with confidence. Gross written premium is visible and reported below; all other reserve-specific fields are left null and explained in data_quality_notes.
data.data_quality_notes: The source images of the annual report are low-resolution / rotated and OCR failed for many pages. I could clearly read the Technical Account row 'Gross premiums written' for 2023 (shown as 2,425,384 in the PDF tables) and have reported it as 2,425.384 million in the native currency. However, the Balance Sheet and Technical Provisions notes (which contain the gross claims outstanding and the 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' GROSS figures required) are not legible enough to extract reliable numeric values or verbatim prior-year movement text. There are multiple references to transfers and reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transactions in the technical provisions notes which would distort a triangle-based extraction; due to image clarity I have not attempted to compute prior-year development from the claims development table. If you can provide a higher-resolution PDF or the specific pages (Balance Sheet liabilities - 'Claims outstanding' and the Technical Provisions note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding'), I can extract the requested fields precisely.
